				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 2 }
				NOT = { cc_office_holds_any = yes }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = { text = cc_office_master_of_the_silk_road_tt }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_the_silk_road }
	}

	# Master of Ceremonies
	option = {
		name = cc_office.1.master_of_ceremonies
		trigger = {
			cc_office_master_of_ceremonies_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			scope:office_holder = {
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 2 }
				NOT = { cc_office_holds_any = yes }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = { text = cc_office_master_of_ceremonies_tt }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_ceremonies }
	}

	# Nothing available. Always shown last so the event can never present zero
	# options, which would leave the player unable to dismiss it.
	option = {
		name = cc_office.1.none
	}
}

# The Household tab's Appoint button on one office: whom to name.
# root = country. The office is flagged cc_office_panel_<key>.
cc_office.3 = {
	type = country_event
	title = cc_office.3.title
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { NOT = { exists = scope:cc_office_cand_1 } }
				desc = cc_office.3.desc_none
			}
			desc = cc_office.3.desc
		}
	}
	outcome = neutral

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
	}

	immediate = {
		cc_office_panel_save_candidates = yes
		cc_xp_dedupe_picks = { P = cc_office_cand }
	}

	option = {
		name = cc_office.3.cand_1
		trigger = { exists = scope:cc_office_cand_1 }
		cc_office_panel_tooltip = yes
		cc_office_panel_appoint = { WHO = scope:cc_office_cand_1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = cc_office.3.cand_2
		trigger = { exists = scope:cc_office_cand_2 }
		cc_office_panel_tooltip = yes
		cc_office_panel_appoint = { WHO = scope:cc_office_cand_2 }
	}
	option = {
		name = cc_office.3.cand_3
		trigger = { exists = scope:cc_office_cand_3 }
		cc_office_panel_tooltip = yes
		cc_office_panel_appoint = { WHO = scope:cc_office_cand_3 }
	}
	option = {
		name = cc_office.3.cand_4
		trigger = { exists = scope:cc_office_cand_4 }
		cc_office_panel_tooltip = yes
		cc_office_panel_appoint = { WHO = scope:cc_office_cand_4 }
	}
	option = {
		name = cc_office.3.none
		hidden_effect = { cc_office_panel_clear = yes }
	}
}

			has_variable = cc_office_evt_keeper_of_regnal_chronicles
			has_variable = cc_office_evt_master_of_the_silk_road
			has_variable = cc_office_evt_master_of_ceremonies
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cc_office_take_event = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = cc_office.19.a
		add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax  multiply = -1  max = -5 }
		add_political_influence = political_influence_weak_bonus
	}
	option = {
		name = cc_office.19.b
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate  value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
	}
	option = {
		name = cc_office.19.c
		trigger = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = cc_office_evt_tt_tenure
				var:cc_office_evt_tenure >= 5
			}
		}
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate  value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
		add_political_influence = political_influence_weak_bonus
		scope:cc_office_evt_holder ?= { cc_xp_gain_dominant = { AMOUNT = 15 } cc_xp_recompute = yes }
	}
}
